notes: Verse 13 adds that the Moon's yogas can override the results of other yogas and should be weighed carefully.

skipped.reason: Moon's navamsa by day/night birth aspected by Jupiter/Venus: needs day/night birth and navamsa relationship.

variants.text: The Moon is in an angle from the Sun: wealth, intelligence and skill are modest.
The Moon is in a succedent house (2nd, 5th, 8th or 11th) from the Sun: wealth, intelligence and skill are middling.
The Moon is in a cadent house (3rd, 6th, 9th or 12th) from the Sun: wealth, intelligence and skill are excellent.

rules.text: Adhi Yoga (benefics in the 6th, 7th and 8th from the Moon): rise to leadership — as head, senior adviser or commander — in proportion to the strength of the planets forming it.

variants.text: Dhana Yoga from the Moon: all the benefics are in the growth houses (3rd, 6th, 10th, 11th) from the Moon, indicating great affluence.
Dhana Yoga from the Moon: two benefics are in the growth houses (3rd, 6th, 10th, 11th) from the Moon, indicating moderate wealth.
Dhana Yoga from the Moon: one benefic is in the growth houses (3rd, 6th, 10th, 11th) from the Moon, indicating a little wealth.

rules.text: Sunapha Yoga (a planet other than the Sun in the 2nd from the Moon): high standing, intelligence, wealth and fame, with wealth earned by one's own effort.
Anapha Yoga (a planet other than the Sun in the 12th from the Moon): high standing and good general health; virtuous, well known, charming and blessed with every kind of happiness.
Durudhara Yoga (planets other than the Sun on both sides of the Moon): enjoyment of all comforts, generosity, wealth and vehicles, and excellent people in one's service.

Kemadruma Yoga (the Moon isolated, with no planet beside it or in the angles): periods of low standing, financial hardship and setbacks, with obstacles to learning. The translator notes it is cancelled when the Moon is exalted or in a great friend's sign and aspected by Jupiter, or has other planetary support.

variants.text: Here the Moon is dignified or aspected by Jupiter, which substantially offsets the yoga.
